simulate_hmm

Source: R/technicals.R
simulate_hmm.Rd

A utility function to simulate hidden markov time-series in base R. Used by sem_prices().

simulate_hmm(n_steps, hmm_fit)

Arguments

n_steps

length of time-series

hmm_fit

listof HMM parameters

Value

vector of values of length n_steps

Examples

simulate_hmm(100,hmm_fit)
